SQL:
SELECT
  customers__regions.id AS "orders.customers.regions.id",
  customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
  orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
WHERE
  NOT customers.region_id IS NULL
GROUP BY
  customers__regions.id,
  customers__regions.name,
  orders.customer_id
LIMIT 21

Error executing tool query: stage 'orders': rendered output columns ['customers__region_id', 'customers__regions__name', 'customer_id', 'rev'] do not match the expected schema ['region_id', 'region_name', 'customer_id', 'rev'].

SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_cust AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.region_id" AS "customers__region_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.regions.name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.rev" AS "rev"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers.region_id AS "orders.customers.region_id",
      customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev"
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
      ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.region_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      customers.region_id,
      customers__regions.name,
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."cust.customers__region_id" AS "customers__region_id",
    _stage_inner."cust.rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id" AS "rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id",
    _stage_inner."cust.rev_max_partition_by_customers__region_id" AS "rev_max_partition_by_customers__region_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      cust.customers__region_id AS "cust.customers__region_id",
      SUM(cust.rev) AS "cust.rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id",
      MAX(cust.rev) AS "cust.rev_max_partition_by_customers__region_id"
    FROM __slayer_stage_cust AS cust
    GROUP BY
      cust.customers__region_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  cust.customers__region_id AS "cust.customers__region_id",
  cust.customers__regions__name AS "cust.customers__regions__name",
  cust.customer_id AS "cust.customer_id",
  cust.rev AS "cust.rev",
  _cm_rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id."rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id" AS "cust.region_rev",
  _cm_rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id."rev_max_partition_by_customers__region_id" AS "cust.max_rev"
FROM __slayer_stage_cust AS cust
LEFT JOIN _cm_rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id
  ON cust.customers__region_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id."customers__region_id"
GROUP BY
  cust.customers__region_id,
  cust.customers__regions__name,
  cust.customer_id,
  cust.rev,
  _cm_rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id."rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id",
  _cm_rev_sum_partition_by_customers__region_id."rev_max_partition_by_customers__region_id"
ORDER BY
  "cust.customers__region_id" ASC,
  "cust.rev" DESC
LIMIT 400

args.message: In each region, the top customer brings in between about 3.5% and 7% of the region's revenue. North: customer 130 (≈3.5%). South: customer 57 (≈3.7%). East: customer 93 (≈5.4%). West: customer 53 (≈7.0%). Revenue is the sum of all order amounts, including orders with status 'bad'. Customers without a region and orders that don't match any customer are left out. No region had a tie for top customer.
